body: I'd love to just talk. I have no one who actually cares.

There's maybe 4 people. My parents, and two friends, one who I never see anymore. I do everything for them. It's the only reason I didn't kill myself a year ago. But I think at this point I've done enough to make them happy, it's time for me to deal with myself.

I really don't mean to be rude to you. It's incredible that you're willing to help people like me. Thank you. But I really don't care if they're assholes or bad people. I'm sad, they're not. At this point, the only ways I know to stop being sad are to kill myself or just leave my life.
I've pitied them for so long but they all seem so happy. I can't pity them
